name: io.github.integrarobot/whyhumanoid
title: Why Humanoid?
description: Search humanoid robots, deployments and components with sources, dates and evidence.

com.whyhumanoid/catalogue.publicAccess: Public access needs no account or key. The free catalogue is available in full. Deployments and Components expose only their public summaries and sources to visitors. An active data subscription and an API key provide the complete records.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: The catalogue categories and tables, what each holds, and what this connection can read from each.

tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.title: Search the catalogue
tools.description: Full-text search across the categories, with common tags. Subscribers search every field; others search the public values.

tags.description: Optional comma-separated tag ids from earlier results

page.description: Optional results page, from 1 to 50; default 1

tools.name: get_rows
tools.title: Read rows of a table
tools.description: Rows of one table (ids from list_categories), in catalogue order, optionally filtered by text. Free tables return every field; Deployments and Components return every field with an active subscription and their public fields otherwise.

table.description: Table id, e.g. deployments, hardware, humanoids, software

query.description: Optional text to search within row values, up to 100 characters; ignores case for A-Z letters

limit.description: Optional number of rows to return, from 1 to 100; default 25

offset.description: Optional number of rows to skip before returning, from 0 to 100000; default 0

tools.name: get_atlas
tools.title: Read a published atlas
tools.description: A published snapshot: datasets, benchmarks, reports (research conclusions), integrators or evolution (the seven charts). Public for everyone.

name.description: Atlas to read: datasets, benchmarks, reports, integrators, evolution

tools.name: get_relations
tools.title: Read the relations graph
tools.description: Links between deployment records, catalogue robots and companies. Subscribers get the full graph; others the graph built from public values.

tools.name: account_status
tools.title: Account status
tools.description: Whether this connection has an active data subscription, and the fair-use limits.

tags.description: Use comma-separated IDs from earlier search facets in tags. The hq: prefix filters company country, site: filters deployment country, and platform: filters robot mobility. Only records with the corresponding tags can match.

payload.description: Humanoid row responses include verification.by_row_id keyed by the unchanged row id. Read metrics.payload_sustained_bilateral_kg for sustained bilateral payload; Pending_Audit and not_disclosed are not zero. Do not parse the legacy Payload/carry (kg) string into this metric. Apply client-side thresholds only to this exact metric with its evidence tier, freshness and conditions; compare only matching reviewed comparison_group values. Peak, single-arm and unclassified payload remain separate. The server has no numeric payload filter.
